name: run-finished-wrong-thread-id-fatal
description: a RUN_FINISHED naming a different threadId than the run's RUN_STARTED is fatal — both boundary events carry the input's threadId, so a close about another conversation cannot close this run
kill: stop recording the open run's threadId at RUN_STARTED, or stop comparing RUN_FINISHED.threadId against it, and the run closes under a conversation nobody asked about
